# 古尊宿語錄

**ID:** X1315
**Volume:** X68
**Category:** 禪宗部類
**Original Category:** 諸宗著述部／禪宗語錄通集
**Byline:** 宋 賾藏主集
**Dynasty:** 宋
**Date:** 960–1279
**Juans:** 48

## Contributors

## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A forty-eight-juan Southern-Sòng Chán *yǔlù* comprehensive-anthology, X68 n1315. Non-commentary; *commentedTextid* omitted. The text was navigated via the companion table-of-contents [KR6q0260](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6q/KR6q0260) compiled by Mujaku Dōchū in Tokugawa Japan.

Structure: the collection gathers the *yǔlù* or selected-sayings of approximately 20+ major Chán masters from the Táng through the Northern Sòng. Contents include materials by classic masters such as [Yúnmén Wényǎn](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%96%87%E5%81%83) 雲門文偃, [Fǎyǎn Wényì](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%96%87%E7%9B%8A) 法眼文益, [Wǔzǔ Fǎyǎn](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%B3%95%E6%BC%94) 五祖法演, and others. The collection's comprehensiveness and authoritative selection made it one of the standard reference-works of Southern-Sòng Chán education.

The earlier Northern-Sòng compact version of this collection circulated as *Gǔ zūnsù yǔyào* 古尊宿語要 (20 masters); Zézàngzhǔ's Southern-Sòng expanded recension into 48 juan became the canonical form.

**Abstract**

[Sēngtǐng Zézàngzhǔ](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E8%B3%BE%E8%97%8F) 僧挺賾藏主 (Shàoxīng-era active = 1131–1162): Southern-Sòng Línjì-Yángqí monk. Dharma-heir of [Zhúān Shìguī](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%A3%AB%E7%8F%AA) 竹菴士珪. Held the position of *zàngzhǔ* (library-keeper) at Fúzhōu Gǔshānsì 福州鼓山寺, whence his characteristic name. Otherwise biographical details meagre; his principal surviving contribution is the present *Gǔ zūnsù yǔlù* compilation.

Dating: *notBefore* 1131 (Shàoxīng era begins); *notAfter* 1162 (Shàoxīng era ends / Gāozōng abdicates).
